beats.label: S1 · A daughter named heir
beats.text: King Viserys, unable to save his queen or their newborn son, breaks a century of tradition by naming his teenage daughter Rhaenyra heir over his brother Daemon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The founding decision; every faction and grievance in the show flows from it.

beats.label: S1 · Alicent becomes queen
beats.text: Otto Hightower sends his young daughter Alicent to comfort the grieving king; she becomes queen and bears him a son, Aegon, quietly splitting the court in two.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Creates the rival male heir and the Green faction around him — the whole coming war.

beats.label: S1 · The brown-haired sons
beats.text: A decade on, Rhaenyra's three brown-haired sons are widely rumoured to be Ser Harwin Strong's, and Alicent becomes certain her own son Aegon must inherit instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Grounds Alicent's belief that opposing Rhaenyra is defending legitimacy, not stealing a crown.

beats.label: S1 · Vhagar and a secret wedding
beats.text: At Laena's funeral Aemond claims the huge dragon Vhagar and loses an eye to Luke; Alicent lunges at the boy with a blade, and Rhaenyra secretly weds her uncle Daemon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Aemond gains the war's deadliest weapon; Daemon and Rhaenyra fuse their claim into one.

beats.label: S1 · A dying king misheard
beats.text: Bedridden and dying, Viserys mutters Aegon the Conqueror's prophecy of a promised prince; Alicent hears her son Aegon's name and believes the king finally changed his heir.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives the Green coup its moral pretext — it rests on a real misunderstanding, not pure malice.

beats.label: S1 · The Green coup
beats.text: Otto and the Small Council crown Aegon II by force and jail dissenting lords; Rhaenys escapes on Meleys to Dragonstone, where Rhaenyra is proclaimed the true queen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two rival monarchs now exist in Westeros; the Dance of the Dragons has officially begun.

beats.label: S1 · Vhagar devours Luke
beats.text: Luke rides to Storm's End to win the Baratheons but Aemond on Vhagar overtakes him; the dragons defy their riders and Vhagar swallows Luke, ending any hope of peace.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First dragon-on-dragon killing; guarantees the war will be personal and total for Rhaenyra.

cliffhanger.text: Rhaenyra has just learned that Aemond killed her son Luke on Vhagar. Both sides now command dragons, armies are gathering, and neither faction can climb down.
questions: How will Rhaenyra answer the killing of her son — against Aemond alone, or all the Greens?
Can Daemon be trusted to fight her war without seizing it as his own?
Which of the great houses will kneel to which claimant now that the war is open?

characters.name: Rhaenyra Targaryen
characters.line: Named heir by her father and now declared the true queen on Dragonstone; her son Luke has just been killed.

characters.name: Daemon Targaryen
characters.line: Rhaenyra's uncle and secret husband; commands a dragon and pushes hard for immediate war.

characters.name: Alicent Hightower
characters.line: Dowager queen and mother of the crowned Aegon II; convinced her dying husband named her son heir.

characters.name: Aegon II Targaryen
characters.line: Crowned king by his grandfather's coup though he never sought the throne; dissolute and easily led.

characters.name: Aemond Targaryen
characters.line: One-eyed prince who rides the largest dragon in the world, Vhagar; has just killed Luke against his own command.

characters.name: Otto Hightower
characters.line: Hand of the King and architect of the Green coup; committed to keeping his grandson Aegon on the Iron Throne.

beats.label: S2 · Blood and Cheese
beats.text: Daemon's hired assassins fail to find Aemond and instead murder King Aegon's small heir Jaehaerys in his bed, opening the war on the worst possible footing for Rhaenyra.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rhaenyra draws first blood in a way that costs her the moral high ground before real fighting begins.

beats.label: S2 · Cole made Hand
beats.text: Aegon publicly hangs every ratcatcher in the city in revenge; a horrified Otto is dismissed as Hand and replaced by the far harsher Ser Criston Cole.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends any chance of a restrained Green response — the diplomat is gone, the swordsman rules.

beats.label: S2 · A meeting in the Sept
beats.text: Rhaenyra sneaks into King's Landing and meets Alicent, realising too late that Alicent misheard Viserys's dying words about the wrong Aegon; peace still fails.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the private doubt in Alicent that later drives her to switch sides.

beats.label: S2 · Rook's Rest
beats.text: At Rook's Rest, Aemond and Vhagar burn Meleys and Sunfyre together, killing Rhaenys and leaving Aegon comatose and disfigured; Aemond takes the regency in his brother's place.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The war's first great battle: Blacks lose a dragon-rider, Greens lose their king to injury but gain a regent.

beats.label: S2 · Daemon breaks at Harrenhal
beats.text: Daemon takes Harrenhal but is unmanned by prophetic visions the witch Alys Rivers feeds him, and the Riverlanders refuse to march for him after Blackwood atrocities.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rhaenyra's ground army stalls exactly when she needs it; Daemon's authority as consort collapses.

beats.label: S2 · The dragonseeds claim their dragons
beats.text: Needing more riders, Rhaenyra summons Targaryen bastards to Dragonstone: the smith Hugh Hammer claims Vermithor and the rogue Ulf claims Silverwing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Flips the dragon count decisively toward Rhaenyra, but on the backs of two men no Targaryen trusts.

beats.label: S2 · Alicent defects
beats.text: Alicent slips to Dragonstone offering to yield King's Landing if her family is spared; Rhaenyra demands Aegon's death, and armies across the realm mobilise for full war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The last off-ramp closes; Alicent has crossed sides and the field battles are next.

cliffhanger.text: Rhaenyra now commands four war-dragons to Aemond's one, Aegon lies burned and comatose in the Red Keep, and armies from the Reach, the North, and the Riverlands are on the march.
questions: Will Aemond strike first before Rhaenyra's new riders master their dragons?
Can Daemon deliver a Riverlands army against Cole's forces marching on Harrenhal?
Will bastard-born Hugh and Ulf stay loyal to a queen who valued them only for their blood?

characters.name: Rhaenyra Targaryen
characters.line: The Black Queen at Dragonstone; commands four war-dragons and will accept no peace short of Aegon's death.

characters.name: Daemon Targaryen
characters.line: Holds Harrenhal after prophetic visions turned him from his own ambition, but has failed to raise the Riverlands for his wife.

characters.name: Aegon II Targaryen
characters.line: Comatose and severely burned after Rook's Rest; his throne is held by his brother in his absence.

characters.name: Aemond Targaryen
characters.line: Prince Regent while Aegon lies broken; the sole Green dragon-rider of consequence, on Vhagar.

characters.name: Alicent Hightower
characters.line: Dismissed from her son's council; has secretly offered to hand King's Landing to Rhaenyra if her family is spared.

characters.name: Ser Criston Cole
characters.line: Hand of the King and Aemond's chosen commander, marching an army on Daemon's Harrenhal.
